purpose: Validated starting parameters for the DDLS microscope Ralph loop

scope.transfer_policy: Use as starting values for other owned wells/plates, then verify with status and a conservative pilot

fluorescence.policy: Reduce exposure/intensity when saturated; do not increase settings on blank-white frames

workflow: Autofocus once per well before the first real snap
Repeat promising fields to assess motion
Run fluorescence only on high-scoring brightfield fields
Use BF1 -> FL -> BF2 for paired comparisons
Verify matching position_mm.z between comparable frames
Save full-resolution images, thumbnails, and complete metadata
Back off and retry 429/503 responses using retry_after_s
